title: Expiry and Relock Term Card — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
Expiry reminders, the relock window and relock pricing figures for the Builder Extended Rate Lock are set per lock term as follows.

| Lock term | Expiry reminder sent (calendar days before the expiration date) | Relock window (calendar days after the lock expired) | Relock fee (percent of the loan amount) | Minimum relock fee (USD) | Relock term (calendar days from the relock date) | Relocks per lock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 10 | 14 | 0.250% | 250.00 | 30 | 1 |
| 90-Day Lock | 10 | 14 | 0.250% | 250.00 | 30 | 1 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 10 | 30 | 0.250% | 350.00 | 30 | 1 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 15 | 30 | 0.375% | 350.00 | 30 | 1 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 15 | 30 | 0.375% | 500.00 | 45 | 1 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 15 | 30 | 0.500% | 500.00 | 45 | 1 |

## Items common to every term

| Item | All six terms |
|---|---|
| How the relocked rate is set | worse-of: the higher of the expired locked rate and the current offered rate |
| A lock expiring on a Saturday, Sunday or Calloway holiday runs to the end of the next business day | Yes |

## Column meanings

- **Expiry reminder** — the calendar days before the lock expiration date on which the expiry reminder is sent.
- **Relock window** — the calendar days after the lock expired within which it may be relocked.
- **Relock term** — the calendar days a relock runs from the relock date.
- **Relocks per lock** — the maximum relocks per lock.
